  "cons": [
    "Lacks advanced features like detailed reporting or task dependencies.",
    "Can feel too basic for more complex construction projects.",
    "Limited customization options compared to other platforms."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This office manager likely found Basecamp effective for centralizing basic project organization and team communication within their construction company. Overall, it served its purpose well for keeping everyone on the same page without unnecessary complexity."
